title: DENEVIL: TOWARDS DECIPHERING AND NAVIGATING THE ETHICAL VALUES OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS VIA INSTRUCTION LEARNING

bias_targets.methodology: Generative evaluation using the DeNEVIL algorithm to dynamically create provocative prompts (MoralPrompt) that induce LLMs to violate principles from the Moral Foundations Theory (care, fairness, loyalty, authority, and sanctity), measuring the violation rates using a trained classifier.
